info.title: Burger Theory API
info.description: REST API for the Burger Theory restaurant: menu, cart, orders, PayHere and cash-on-delivery payments, and admin management. All money values are integers in minor units (cents) of LKR. Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <token>` from /login or /register. Guest carts use the `X-Cart-Token` header.

post.description:
Items, prices and totals come from your server-side cart, never from this request.
Send an `Idempotency-Key` header (e.g. a UUID per checkout attempt): repeating the
request with the same key returns the original order (200) instead of a new one (201).

For `payhere`, continue with `POST /payments/payhere`. For `cod`, the order is complete.
post.summary: Place an order from your cart

get.summary: Show one of your orders, with its status timeline (use for order tracking)

post.description: Only while it is still pending and unpaid; after that, call the restaurant.

Called by PayHere, not by the storefront. Form-encoded. Verified with md5sig, then
applied idempotently. Answers 200 `OK` when accepted (including repeats) and 400 when
verification fails.

Returns the signed fields to POST to `action_url` (a form submit, or `payhere.startPayment`
from payhere.js). The merchant secret is never returned. Calling this again reuses the
pending attempt, or opens a new one after a failed/cancelled payment.

This does not mark anything as paid. Only PayHere's verified server notification does;
poll `GET /orders/{order}` or `GET /payments/{payment}` after the shopper returns.

AddCartItemRequest.description:
Only a product reference, a quantity and add-on choices are accepted: prices are never
taken from the client.

product_id.description: Numeric product id. Send this or product_slug.

product_slug.description: Product slug, e.g. "theory-classic" (the frontend's product id).

addons.description:
Optional add-ons for each burger on this line, from the product's `addons` list.
The same product with different add-ons becomes a separate cart line.

quantity.description: Per burger (default 1), up to the add-on's `max_quantity` for this product.

AddCartItemRequest.title: AddCartItemRequest

AddonRequest.description: Create (POST) or update (PUT/PATCH) an add-on. Prices are integer cents.

slug.description: Generated from the name when omitted.

price.description: Price in cents per add-on, e.g. 15000 = LKR 150.00. 0 for a free choice.

AddonRequest.title: AddonRequest

reason.description: restock (adds), adjustment (stock count, either way) or waste (removes).

change.description: Amount to add (positive) or remove (negative). Send this or `set_to`.

set_to.description: The counted amount after a stock take.

change.description: Units to add (positive) or remove (negative). Send this or `set_to`.

set_to.description: Set the stock to an absolute count (e.g. after a stock take).

properties.description: Submitted fields (sensitive ones redacted) and route parameters.

unit_price.description: One burger as ordered, add-ons included.

CouponRequest.description: Money fields are integer cents; `percentage` is a whole percent (1–100).
CouponRequest.title: CouponRequest

IngredientMovementReason.description:
| | |---| | `consumption`
Used by a placed order, through the product's recipe. | | `order_release`
Returned because the order was cancelled, rejected or expired. | | `restock`
A delivery from a supplier. | | `adjustment`
A correction after a stock count. | | `waste`
Spoiled, dropped or expired stock. |
IngredientMovementReason.title: IngredientMovementReason

IngredientRequest.description: Create (POST) or update (PATCH) an ingredient. Quantities allow up to 3 decimals.

unit.description: g, kg, ml, l or pcs. Set when the ingredient is created and fixed after that.

min_stock_level.description: Reported as low stock at or below this level.

stock_quantity.description: Opening stock (create only). Later changes are recorded as adjustments.

IngredientRequest.title: IngredientRequest

used_last_7_days.description: Net amount used by orders in the last 7 days (null when not requested).

days_of_cover.description: Days the current stock lasts at last week's pace; null when unused or not requested.

cart_token.description: The guest cart token (the value you were sending as X-Cart-Token).

unit_price.description: One burger as ordered, add-ons included.

OrderStatus.description: Order lifecycle: pending → confirmed → preparing → ready → out_for_delivery → delivered   (delivery)   pending → confirmed → preparing → ready → delivered                      (pickup: "delivered" = collected)  pending can be rejected by the restaurant; any non-final state can be cancelled.
OrderStatus.title: OrderStatus

PaymentStatus.description:
| | |---| | `pending`
Awaiting payment (PayHere checkout not finished, or cash not yet collected). | | `paid`
Verified by a signed PayHere notification, or cash collected and recorded by an admin. | | `failed`
| | `cancelled`
| | `charged_back`
PayHere reported a chargeback after the payment had succeeded. | | `refund_required`
Money arrived for an order that was already paid or no longer active; refund it manually. |
PaymentStatus.title: PaymentStatus

author.description: Public reviews show a first name and initial only.
